version.author: nvk
version.changelog: 2.18.7 Features - Choose pre-render, post-render and post-add actions directly in Render SMART settings - Highlight removed and inserted text in the Rename preview - Add Rename wildcards for item, track and project information, with Unicode-aware capitalization and improved UCS numbering - Redesign Render SMART's file list, presets and output options, including automatic mono/stereo detection and per-item overrides - Choose whether to render named folder items only or include other selected items; preview all named folder items without a selection - Preview rendered files, drag them to other applications with nvk_API, or open their output folders - Save Render SMART settings with items or projects, and save Folder Items presets per project with dedicated actions - Add Track Override actions, a mouse-cursor solo action, and Create new folder name and eligibility settings - Choose the starting number and leading zeros in Folder Item Settings with a live numbering preview; preset tabs show their action numbers Improvements and fixes - Recover previous audio after a cancelled or failed overwrite, including on Windows without nvk_API - Respect Cancel, Skip and incremented filenames when render outputs already exist - Match each primary and secondary render to the correct source item in Render SMART and AUDITION - Finish renders when the REAPER preference to save render statistics is disabled - Continue copying after a matching output, relink takes to the project copy, and report copy or relink failures - Replace each literal match once in Rename and Render SMART filenames - Preserve existing files when queuing jobs or renaming render variants unless overwrite is selected for delivery - Select folder items with a single-space name when running Select unnamed folder items - Keep imported Vordio clips and captions out of folder item selections, even in previously tagged projects - Keep the new name readable in narrow Rename windows and preserve the preview height when switching naming modes - Improve Rename, Reposition, Render SMART and Settings layouts at small sizes, keeping preset and results controls reachable - Type seconds into Render SMART tail and fade fields; double-click a disabled Tail, Fade, Normalize or Limit value to enable and edit it - Prevent scrolling from changing dropdown values, protect preset resets and mouse assignments, and report save failures - Preserve tracks with sends when cleaning render folders and keep Region Render Matrix routing when folder items move or resize - Fix marker and region synchronization across project tabs, undo and muted tracks - Fix Fade actions on fixed lanes and folder tracks, preserving automatic crossfade curves in REAPER 7.81 and later - Fade out shortens an overlapping fade-in to the cursor position, including on folder volume automation - Fix Rename clipboard and marker targets after undo, and save persistent Rename settings with each project - Keep automation fitting within folder item bounds and fix Reposition number entry and moving automation - Remove leftover automatic folder items from ineligible tracks, preserve named ones, and leave unrelated empty items alone - Keep names when folder items merge and stop ineligible named folder items from selecting underlying items - Fix Render SMART output paths, freezes, settings recovery and silent sausage renders from tracks with offset parent sends - Keep Render SMART loop seams exact when REAPER's split-crossfade preference is on - Support custom installation paths, including Windows paths with non-English characters 2.17.0 New mouse cursor scripts 2.16.0 Moved experimental disable auto naming setting to main folder items settings. Now there is a new setting for auto naming which can be enabled, disabled, or only numbers. Only numbers is a new setting which automatically numbers folder items but won't automatically name unnamed folder items added to the same track as named folder items. Fixed cursor behavior in Delete Word action in Rename script Remove script: add compatibility with take lanes Rename: default to not auto-detecting UCS names, new setting to auto-detect UCS names on open 2.15.5 Error when using trim scripts with no items selected Allow for UCS names to be created with no SourceID Fix completion/navigation for UCS 2.15.4 Error when selecting UCS user categories in preferences 2.15.3 Allow trimming from edge if target item is partially visible (before it had to be mostly visible) 2.15.2 Setting to color tracks with 'nvk_THEME - Track Colors' after they are created with the 'Create new folder...' script 2.15.1 Error when using Mousewheel Volume script 2.15.0 Compatibility with nvk_SHARED 4.0.0. Make sure to update all your scripts to the latest version. Extra keyboard shortcut for deleting a word from the input text treating underscores and hyphens (ctrl-delete still functions as normal) Rename: shortcut for toggling capitalization For full changelog, visit https://nvk.tools/docs/workflow/folder_items#changelog

version.changelog: 2.7.0 - Redesign the window around Loop and Shepard Tone modes, with collapsible Position and Name settings and persistent Cancel and Apply controls - Add a waveform loop view: drag the splice marker to choose the zero-crossing search and edit the crossfade in a magnified seam view - Play the loop preview with a visible play position; step through selected items with the Left and Right arrow keys - Drag or type crossfade length and curve, nudge them with Alt+arrow keys, and keep them editable with Live preview off - In Shepard Tone mode, drag the overview to change pitch, enter semitones per loop and edit the fade curve - Keep Loop count and Shepard Tone slice count independent, preserving existing preset counts - Show per-item zero-crossing and crossfade results, including seams that cannot be crossfaded - Undo and redo settings with Cmd+Z and Cmd+Shift+Z; undo immediately after Apply restores the original items - Keep settings usable in docked or narrow windows, with clear explanations for disabled controls and items too short to loop - Ask how to handle items outside the time selection, restoring a cleared time selection when canceled - Disable time-selection fitting for Shepard Tone or multiple items on one track; disable Apply when there is nothing to loop - Add New order for shuffled loops; rename Second snap to Snap to whole seconds; Z selects Loop and the P, C and N shortcuts are removed - Remove source extensions and trailing tags by default; when keeping extensions, put loop numbers and suffixes before them - Fix crossfade curves in REAPER 7.81 and later, preserve them through undo and cancellation, and avoid extra fades from split-crossfade preferences - Fix prefixes, suffixes and separators in item names, and crossfade shortcuts when Max fade limits the length - Improve live preview responsiveness with several items selected and support custom installation paths 2.5.0 Compatibility with nvk_SHARED 4.0.0. Make sure to update all your scripts to the latest version. For full changelog, visit https://nvk.tools/docs/loopmaker#changelog

version.author: nvk
version.changelog: 2.2.1 Search and browse - Redesign results with compact and detailed views, clearer metadata and a resizable Browse and Tags sidebar - Add an optional sidebar Add button showing where results will go, with more FX insertion options - Rename collections to Tags; tag results from their context menu and assign custom icons and colors - Add Tab-to-browse filters, visible search scopes, Suggested results, a New filter and optional recency/frequency ranking - Improve fuzzy matching, synonyms and relevance sorting, and explain which settings and extensions fuzzy matching needs - Search by action shortcut, assign shortcuts from results and view toggle states - Add searches for Project Templates, Subprojects, Take Markers and individual FX formats - Respect REAPER's Hidden FX folder in REAPER 7.83 and later - Double-click the header to collapse SEARCH; typing or launching it again expands it - Ctrl+R performs a full refresh and rescan; use the heart button to favorite results nvk_MINIMENU and Visual FX - Add a keyboard-driven launcher with folders, shortcuts, recents, a Chain Library, persistent and stay-open modes - Import and export layouts, REAPER toolbars and FX favorites; undo, redo, repeat or randomize commands - Browse FX with thumbnails or full-interface previews, bulk capture, custom PNGs and graphical JSFX - Recapture screenshots for multiple selected effects, including selections across plug-in formats - Insert into FX containers, target or replace focused chains and reveal plug-in paths - Show Visual FX cards with names below their previews; capture screenshots of scripts as well as effects - Open preview layout and capture settings beside Visual results; resize previews with Ctrl/Cmd+scroll - Visual FX requires the nvk_API extension package from ReaPack Improvements and fixes - Keep launch shortcuts from reaching REAPER when reopening SEARCH - Build the index in the background and improve large-library performance, keyboard navigation and drag-and-drop - Save tags, favorites and settings as they change so a REAPER crash no longer loses them - Keep narrow windows readable, confirm tag removal and keep MiniMenu entries stationary when batch actions appear - Keep persistent searches, filters, favorites and project results current after reopening, rescanning or changing projects - Fix the New filter disappearing after rescans and searches ignoring the character after a closing quote - Fix Enter on scrolled-out results, FX-slot actions, Clear folders and inserting AU plug-ins without manufacturer names - Fix MiniMenu FX-favorites import and removed project directories remaining searchable - Fix errors with pinned folders, deleted project objects, saved settings without ReaPack and Windows paths with non-English characters - Apply Instrument tracks auto-arm when selected to existing tracks receiving an instrument 1.20.0 Added 'Take Marker' as a result type Fix error when adding fx to a folder with the right click menu when an empty folder name exists 1.19.1 Improve behavior when nvk_SEARCH is set to always on top and a project is loaded with prompts in the same location as the script. Not completely fixed, recommend not using 'Always on Top' if possible 1.19.0 Updated layout for preferences window Reduce flicker when opening palette mode 1.18.3 Adding subprojects as a result type. Filter key for project templates is now 'n' instead of 's'. 1.18.2 Selecting multiple results and pressing enter will now add all of them properly Sidebar can now be moved to the right side of the window Font improvements 1.18.1 Fix for error when timestamps aren't parsed correctly New tracks added with drag and drop will now be selected and set to last touched in order to match behavior of the built-in FX browser Error when parsing smart fx folders with no string match 1.18.0 Compatibility with nvk_SHARED 4.0.0. Make sure to update all your scripts to the latest version. For full changelog, visit https://nvk.tools/docs/search#changelog

version.author: nvk
version.changelog: 5.2.2 Appearance and controls - Search installed REAPER actions by name or command ID directly in Startup Actions and other action pickers - Support editing matching appearance settings and keyboard shortcuts directly in Preferences search - Add Light and Dark themes and accent presets in Preferences, with an option to give each script its own appearance - Combine theme and style editing in one Advanced window with Save and Cancel; remove the whole-theme color sliders - Add nvk_SANS and nvk_MONO fonts, searchable font previews, and global font and zoom settings - Refresh Preferences, toolbars, presets, selectors and color pickers, with improved readability at different sizes - Remove the animated Party Mode theme - Add custom waveform gradients, opacity and docked-theme brightness controls; move Waveform color into Preferences - Improve preset menus, confirm removal, and save edits to inactive presets - Add Reset all settings and Clear all user data, preserving saved presets and user work during a settings reset - Preserve theme and accent changes made in other scripts while appearance settings are open - Use the script background when Match REAPER when docked is off, unless a custom docked background is set Windows and shortcuts - Show which actions will lose a keyboard shortcut before reassigning it or restoring default bindings - Reopen single-instance windows without REAPER’s running-script prompt when a compatible nvk_API is installed - Improve docking, FX pickers, keyboard shortcuts, macOS shortcut labels and Startup Actions organization - Add Disable drag to dock in Preferences and let Tab and Shift+Tab move between number fields - Show full dropdown names and values on hover, keyboard focus outlines, and built-in shortcut restrictions - Keep long toolbar hover text readable and explain how to retry a failed FX screenshot capture - Keep screenshot menus stable while hovering over their controls - Fix trackpad scrolling stepping unevenly on controls and prevent controls from opening the empty-space context menu - Add a License section to paid scripts' Preferences and fix Open License Manager reporting that nvk_SHARED is missing Reliability - Keep overlapping child items in a folder selection when a later, shorter item ends before the folder - Fix take detection missing later sounds when REAPER returns only part of a waveform - Preserve existing files when copying audio fails and reduce memory used for large copies - Restore MCP tools and rendering when SWS and js_ReaScriptAPI are absent - Recognize a single-space item name as unnamed - Ignore Vordio video clips and captions that were previously tagged as folder items - Fix errors when scrolling dialogs - Save settings safely, recover after a failure, and keep presets and user data safe if a script closes during a settings reset - Fix settings saves on full disks and loading from network installations or Windows paths with non-English characters - Fix freezes in small or scrolled windows, delayed freezes after opening, and Windows scripts closing while still focused - Add optional anonymous error reporting and show complete errors in the console - Fix REAPER no longer redrawing after a script error during an edit - Improve performance with large item selections, highlighted search results and long font lists - Preserve curved fades and automatic crossfade curves in REAPER 7.82 and later - Fix take navigation with empty, reversed or looping items and different playback rates; preserve take markers during analysis - Preserve unrelated automation selections, take polarity and MIDI source lengths during item operations - Fix marker, region and envelope errors after undo or deletion; leave unrelated empty items on folder tracks alone - Scroll focused tracks below pinned tracks and fix render-stat weekday text on non-English systems Updates and requirements - Show when REAPER still needs to restart to load an installed update - Recommend the optional nvk_API extension once on supported ReaPack installations - Add automatic updates in Preferences, including beta versions, Check for updates and What's new after an update - Prompt once per session when installed packages need updating together, while keeping older scripts working - Improve update checks on older systems and behind firewalls or proxies, with explanations when a check fails - Order update versions as ReaPack does, including releases following beta versions - Support the nvk tools installer without ReaPack and move updated actions to their correct action-list section - Make SWS and js_ReaScriptAPI optional for supported functionality when nvk_API is installed - Requires ReaImGui 0.10.0.3 or newer 4.4.1 Error when trying to activate a license in the upgrade popup 4.4.0 Allow for disabling close if unfocused in command pallette mode Fix for duplicated markers when undoing folder item duplication Move region ends when moving markers with ripple in nvk_VARIATIONS 4.3.0 Improve behavior when nvk_SEARCH is set to always on top and a project is loaded with prompts in the same location as the script.
